SOURCE: Two provenances, recorded per item in `sourceRef`. (1) `kaoming.com` — transcribed verbatim from https://www.kaoming.com/news-en and /news-tw, decoded from the page's stored layout JSON rather than the rendered DOM, so nothing was paraphrased and nothing was lost to the carousel. (2) `research-2026` — KAOMING_NEWS_RESEARCH_2016-2026, compiled 31 August 2026 from named public sources and supplied by the client. Only entries that document marks VERIFIED are here; PENDING below records what was deliberately withheld.
NAMING_RULE: The source titles its product announcements by legacy code (KMC-321HIS, KMC-RF). CLAUDE.md forbids a legacy code as a displayed name, so each item is titled by the machine TYPE the source itself gives it and carries a `series` reference to the 2026 series page where one exists. The legacy code survives only in `legacyCode`, which is a search synonym and is never rendered.
STALENESS: The newest item KAO MING has published is from 2023. Nothing from 2024–2026 exists to transcribe. This file is the whole section's source: adding an entry here publishes it, in both locales, with no page edit.
IMAGE_POLICY: The source illustrates its internal items (staff incentive tours, the year-end dinner) with photographs of named employees. Those are not republished. Company items use _kit/factory imagery; product items link to the series page and use its catalogue photography.
DATE_NOTE: `datePrecision` says how much of the date the source actually stated — 'day', 'month' or 'year'. The site prints exactly that much and never more: a fabricated '1 January' in a visible date would be a false claim. `date` always carries a full ISO value because it is the sort key and the machine-readable `datetime`.

en.title: High-speed Vertical Machining Center
en.body: Apply Japan's top brand linear guideway, THK, and increase sliders on all three axes to enhance loading capacity response time for machining. Different from the common box type with internal rib, utilize the keel design with stronger bending resistance. Larger the table base to provide strong full support without overhang problem. The design of the inner cooled ballscrew, coolant system in the bearing seat, and motor board with cooling circuit are to reduce thermal growth. Rapid traverse is provided at 32-36 m/min, against an industry average of 30 m/min.

zh.title: 高速立式加工中心機
zh.body: 線軌全面採用日本第一品牌THK，增加線軌滑塊，提升反應速度及載重能力。有別於一般立柱箱型肋骨設計，採用龍骨設計提升整體抗彎抗扭能力。床身底座支撐面積加大，提高機台加工支撐剛性。三軸螺桿通孔、馬達板、軸承座冷卻設計，防止熱昇長維持高精度。快送速度提供 32-36 m/min，超越業界平均 30 m/min。

items.sourceNote: The rapid-traverse sentence was present in the Traditional-Chinese body on kaoming.com and absent from the English one. Restored to the English from the 2026 research file, which states the same figures in English.

en.title: High Rigidity Multi-Face Machining Center
en.body: The combination of a ram-type spindle with a wide range of interchangeable attached heads, and a highly efficient crossbeam-fixed structure make the machine more powerful and versatile. It comes standard with an innovative inline direct-drive spindle inside a ram; speed up to 8000rpm, power up to 22/26KW, torque up to 1000Nm. Thanks to the high rigid structure design, it features more powerful cutting capacity up to 30% than our competitors as the same model.

zh.title: 高剛性多面體加工中心機
zh.body: 主要特色是結合具有多個附加頭可交換的四角柱主軸頭，以及具有高效率的定樑結構，主軸轉速可達 8000rpm，輸出馬力可達 22/26KW，輸出扭距可達 1000Nm，使機器的切削力更強勁，應用也更廣泛。由於高剛性四角柱主軸頭設計，切削能力比同類型競爭者高出 30%。

items.note: Epeius series E7 / EU / E8 / E10 on the current website. No 2026 catalogue exists for it, so there is no series page to link to and no specification beyond what the announcement itself states.

en.title: High Speed Double-Column Machining Center
en.body: The main feature is a ram-type casted spindle head which is supported by four LM guides and it ensures high rigidity and stability under heavy-duty cutting when the Z-axis travel moves up and down in the construction of BOX IN BOX. The Z-axis travel is 850mm option 1500mm. X and Y axes use the oversize and maximum-preloaded roller liner guideways with high rigidity. The spindle is the IDD drive including 40 or 50-taper; the built-in drive and geared-head are optionally available and the high speed is provided 10000rpm, 12000rpm and 15000rpm to diversify the choices.

zh.title: 高速龍門加工中心機
zh.body: 主要特色是配備了 4 支線軌支撐的四角柱主軸頭，使 Z 軸在 BOX IN BOX 的建構中上下移動，確保強力切削之剛性與穩定性。Z 軸 850mm 行程，可客製需求選配超大行程 1050mm。X／Y 軸均配備帶有高剛性最大預壓力之大型滾柱式線性導軌。其主軸為 IDD 直結傳動，BT40／BT50 錐度均可選用；並提供 10000rpm、12000rpm、15000rpm 等多樣化選擇。

en.title: KMC-123EU launched at TMTS 2026
en.body: KAO MING launched the KMC-123EU high-speed vertical double-column machining center at TMTS 2026, built for high-speed, high-precision work in aerospace and mould machining. As reported by the trade press covering the show, it carries a 24,000 rpm built-in spindle (HSK-A63, 25 kW) and an A/C-axis rotary table of 630 mm diameter for full five-axis capability, with travel of X 800 / Y 1,000 / Z 520 mm on linear guideways throughout, a 32-tool changer (40 optional), positioning accuracy of ±0.005 mm and repeatability of ±0.002 mm.

zh.title: KMC-123EU 於 TMTS 2026 發表
zh.body: 高明精機於 TMTS 2026 台灣國際工具機展發表 KMC-123EU 高速立式龍門加工中心機，針對航太與模具加工的高速高精密需求而設。依展會現場國際專業媒體報導，該機配置 24,000 rpm 內建式主軸（HSK-A63，25 kW）及 630 mm A/C 軸轉盤，具備完整五軸加工能力；行程 X 800 / Y 1,000 / Z 520 mm，三軸均採用線性導軌，刀庫 32 把（可選配 40 把），定位精度 ±0.005 mm、重複精度 ±0.002 mm。

en.title: Results of the 2025 Digital Lean Management programme
en.body: KAO MING opened its Houli plant to present the results of the government-supported 2025 Digital Lean Management (TPS) programme. Three outcomes were shown: digital scheduling, for more precise operation of the production line; delivery-date response, which significantly improved customer satisfaction; and inventory control, at lower cost and higher efficiency. The afternoon closed with a tour of the production line. The work continues the Toyota Production System KAO MING adopted in 2016 and the lean management programme of 2019-2020.

zh.title: 114 年數位化精實管理 TPS 計畫成果發表
zh.venue: 高明精機，台中市后里區
zh.body: 高明精機於后里廠舉辦成果發表會，公開 114 年數位化精實管理 TPS 補助計畫的導入成果：數位化排程，使產線運作更為精準；交期回覆，顯著提升客戶滿意度；庫存管控，降低成本並提升效率。活動最後安排產線參觀。該計畫延續 2016 年導入的 TPS 豐田式生產系統，以及 2019-2020 年的精實管理工作。

PRESS_POLICY: Trade-press articles are not KAO MING's to republish. Where third-party coverage exists it is carried as `press`: outlet, date, one short quotation and a link out. That is the credibility marker and the whole of what is reproduced — never an article body, never an article's photograph.
COMPETITOR_NAMES: Two organiser releases list KAO MING among other named exhibitors (TIMTOS 2023 and 2025). Those rosters are recorded in `sourceNote` and are NOT published: CLAUDE.md forbids a named cooperation claim, and a list of other manufacturers on KAO MING's own news page reads as one whether or not it is meant to.
